mapper.select: SELECT M.id AS member_id, M.name, M.birth_date, M.gender, M.email, M.phone, P.id AS profile_id, P.profile_image_url, P.residence_region, P.desired_job, P.desired_region, P.employment_type, P.career_type, P.career_years, P.min_salary, P.work_type, P.wheelchair_required, P.accessible_restroom_required, P.disabled_parking_required, P.assistive_device_required, P.rest_area_required, P.elevator_required, P.contact_time_start, P.contact_time_end, P.contact_method, P.introduction, P.profile_public, P.created_at, P.updated_at FROM member M LEFT JOIN job_seeker_profile P ON M.id = P.member_id WHERE M.id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_seeker_profile ( member_id, profile_image_url, residence_region, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, work_type, wheelchair_required, accessible_restroom_required, disabled_parking_required, assistive_device_required, rest_area_required, elevator_required, contact_time_start, contact_time_end, contact_method, introduction, profile_public ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{residenceRegion}, #{desiredJob}, #{desiredRegion}, #{employmentType}, #{careerType}, #{careerYears}, #{minSalary}, #{workType}, #{wheelchairRequired}, #{accessibleRestroomRequired}, #{disabledParkingRequired}, #{assistiveDeviceRequired}, #{restAreaRequired}, #{elevatorRequired}, NULLIF(#{contactTimeStart}, ''), NULLIF(#{contactTimeEnd}, ''), #{contactMethod}, #{introduction}, #{profilePublic} )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_seeker_profile SET profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, residence_region = #{residenceRegion}, desired_job = #{desiredJob}, desired_region = #{desiredRegion}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, career_type = #{careerType}, career_years = #{careerYears}, min_salary = #{minSalary}, work_type = #{workType}, wheelchair_required = #{wheelchairRequired}, accessible_restroom_required = #{accessibleRestroomRequired}, disabled_parking_required = #{disabledParkingRequired}, assistive_device_required = #{assistiveDeviceRequired}, rest_area_required = #{restAreaRequired}, elevator_required = #{elevatorRequired}, contact_time_start = NULLIF(#{contactTimeStart}, ''), contact_time_end = NULLIF(#{contactTimeEnd}, ''), contact_method = #{contactMethod}, introduction = #{introduction}, profile_public = #{profilePublic}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, birth_date = NULLIF(#{birthDate}, ''), gender = #{gender}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone} WHERE id = #{memberId}
